# InfoHQ — Complete Knowledge Base & Services Documentation

## Company Overview
InfoHQ (legal identifier: InfoHQ, founded 2025 by Shivam Tiwari) is an engineering studio and AI technology company based in Pune (Maharashtra) and Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh), India. InfoHQ operates a hybrid model of high-standard B2B client engineering and proprietary AI SaaS products. InfoHQ delivers end-to-end digital solutions pan-India and globally, with a firm principle of 100% client code and IP ownership.

- Website: https://infohq.in/
- Official Inquiries: contact@infohq.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 83818 35420
- Headquarters: Pune & Prayagraj, India
- Founder & Engineering Lead: Shivam Tiwari

---

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. AI & Intelligent Systems
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/ai-intelligent-systems/
- Summary: Engineering practical autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over enterprise knowledge bases, and custom LLM API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).
- Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, pgvector, PostgreSQL.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Custom enterprise RAG pipelines for unstructured documents, PDFs, manuals, and customer queries.
  - Multi-step autonomous AI agents with tool use (browsing, calculators, internal database queries).
  - Private, compliant LLM architectures adhering to data privacy and encryption standards.
  - Telemetry logging, token usage tracking, and hallucination reduction guardrails.
- Pricing: One-time projects from ₹19,999. Monthly retainer options available.

### 2. Custom Software Development
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/custom-software/
- Summary: End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS platforms, secure backend microservices, high-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs, background queue workers, and internal operational portals.
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Multi-tenant database architecture with role-based access control (RBAC).
  - High-throughput, documented REST and GraphQL endpoints.
  - Reliable background task processors (BullMQ, Celery).
  - Custom enterprise admin portals and real-time dashboards.
- Pricing: Custom quote. SaaS MVP starting package from ₹49,999.

### 3. Modern Web Development
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/web-development/
- Summary: High-converting, sub-second business websites, interactive client portals, and headless CMS integrations built for 95+ Core Web Vitals scores and comprehensive SEO.
- Tech Stack: React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Fast-loading, responsive business websites optimized for mobile and desktop.
  - Full Technical SEO, JSON-LD structured schemas, OpenGraph graphics, and sitemaps.
  - Headless CMS setup for smooth non-technical team updates.
  - Conversion rate optimized CTA funnels and analytics tracking.
- Pricing: Business website from ₹14,999; eCommerce platforms from ₹29,999.

### 4. Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/mobile-app-development/
- Summary: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android featuring offline-first local database caching, background synchronization, biometric security, and push notifications.
- Tech Stack: React Native, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, TypeScript, Firebase, REST APIs.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Clean iOS and Android apps with smooth 60fps animations.
  - Offline-first SQLite/WatermelonDB storage with cloud auto-sync.
  - Biometric login (FaceID / Fingerprint) and hardware sensor integrations.
  - Complete App Store and Google Play Store submission and approval handling.
- Pricing: Native/cross-platform mobile apps from ₹39,999.

### 5. Business Automation & System Integrations
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/business-automation/
- Summary: Custom workflow automation, bi-directional sync across CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce), payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe), communication (WhatsApp Business API, Slack), and automated invoice extraction.
- Tech Stack: Python, Node.js, REST APIs, Webhooks, n8n, Zapier, Make, WhatsApp Cloud API.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Multi-app synchronization pipelines eliminating manual copy-pasting.
  - Automated WhatsApp bot workflows for lead qualification and notifications.
  - Invoice and document processing pipelines with automated OCR.
  - Error alerting, webhook retry mechanisms, and audit logging.
- Pricing: Custom quote per workflow scope; retainer plans available from ₹24,999/month.

### 6. Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure
- URL: https://infohq.in/services/cloud-devops/
- Summary: Scalable cloud architectures on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare; zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions; Docker containerization; proactive monitoring and disaster recovery.
- Tech Stack: AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, PostgreSQL.
- Typical Deliverables:
  - Zero-downtime automated deployment pipelines.
  - Secure VPC, firewall, and sub-second global CDN setup.
  - Database clustering, automated daily backups, and instant rollback strategies.
- Pricing: Retainer-based (Technology Partner plan ₹49,999/mo) or custom setup quote.

### 7. Additional Services
- Cybersecurity: OWASP Top 10 audits, JWT/MFA/RBAC implementation, server hardening (https://infohq.in/services/cybersecurity/).
- Website Maintenance & Support: Daily backups, security patches, ongoing speed tuning (https://infohq.in/services/website-maintenance/).
- UI/UX Design: User research, wireframes, high-fidelity Figma prototypes, and design systems (https://infohq.in/services/ui-ux-design/).
- Brand Design: Logos, visual identity guidelines, investor pitch decks (https://infohq.in/services/brand-design/).
- Social Media Management: Content calendar, branded carousels, technical copywriting (https://infohq.in/services/social-media-management/).
- Digital Marketing: SEO audits, search ad campaigns, GA4 conversion tracking (https://infohq.in/services/digital-marketing/).

## Featured Case Study: SeHAT SmartCare AI
- Case Study URL: https://infohq.in/portfolio/#sehat
- Industry: Healthcare & Clinical AI
- Overview: An intelligent Android healthcare platform combining fine-tuned medical language models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for medical knowledge bases, semantic search, lab report OCR extraction, and multilingual support (English, Hindi, Hinglish). Designed for high-volume accessibility across urban and rural patient populations.

## Published Engineering Knowledge & Technical Articles

1. **What Is RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Why It Matters for Your Business**
   - URL: https://infohq.in/blogs/ai/what-is-rag/
   - Key Insight: Explains how RAG grounds large language models with real company documentation to eliminate hallucinations, maintain real-time accuracy without retraining, and protect private corporate data.

2. **AI Agents vs AI Chatbots: What's the Difference and Which Do You Need?**
   - URL: https://infohq.in/blogs/ai/ai-agents-vs-ai-chatbots/
   - Key Insight: Contrasts passive conversational chatbots with goal-oriented autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step tool execution, database queries, and decision making.

3. **Practical AI for Small Businesses in India: Where to Start and What Works**
   - URL: https://infohq.in/blogs/ai/ai-for-small-business-india/
   - Key Insight: A realistic guide to deploying high-ROI AI solutions (customer query deflection, document parsing, lead follow-ups) for Indian SMBs without large capital expenditure.

4. **AI and Data Privacy for Businesses in India**
   - URL: https://infohq.in/blogs/ai/ai-data-privacy-for-businesses/
   - Key Insight: Navigating compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 when handling client data with third-party LLMs.
